name: Burn Bar
author: nixfred
description: Live thermal heat map of Claude and Codex token burn in one bar slot, with weekly quota gauges and a click-to-open cockpit.

barWidget.description: Token spend as a heat map — Claude burns left, Codex right, newest against the centre line.

schema.label: History window (minutes)
schema.description: How far back the lanes reach. 360 = six hours.

schema.label: Plan-limit refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often Burn Bar asks Omarchy's own usage collectors for fresh Claude and Codex plan limits.

schema.label: Ember flicker
schema.description: Live flicker on hot cells. Turn off to save a little GPU.

schema.label: Rising sparks
schema.description: Embers lifting off the strip while anything is burning.
